snippet.title: Direlands: Extraction — Gameplay Trailer 2 | Demo October 8
snippet.description:
Direlands: Extraction is a spellcasting extraction RPG inspired by games of old. The world was shattered into drifting fragments, and the mages have discovered a way to access them using rifts. Step through, fight past fierce enemies and the bosses that rule each zone, take what gear, gold and spell scrolls you can, and find your way home before the rift closes. Explore in search of new splinters that connect to new fragments and unlock new zones.

🔷 Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4726670/Direlands_Extraction/
🔷 Join the Discord → https://discord.gg/zsf3Kmr9bH

▶ Play the demo October 8.

OPEN WORLD — Explore a vast island of wrecks, ruins, fire and ice, and the bosses that rule it.
STRONGHOLDS — Lay siege to fortified enemy strongholds and the powerful enemies that guard them.
CO-OP & PVPVE — Go solo, bring your party, or battle rival parties for the spoils.
LOOT & GROWTH — Chase rare gear, learn powerful spells and grow stronger with every run.
SUPERS — When the fight turns, call down a meteor, bolster your defenses, freeze enemies solid, or don a crown of lightning to turn it back in your favor.

Made in Unity by Milk Barf Games.

#IndieGame #RPG #ExtractionRPG #CoOp #ARPG #IndieDev #Unity #Magic #GameDev #SteamDemo
